components.html:
Análisis Matemático I

Contexto académico y evidencia concreta.

narrative.overview: The interface feels like a well-used FI-UNJU study notebook whose margin has opened into a precise pixel-art world. Warm ruled paper carries the work; editorial type makes academic decisions legible; cobalt controls keep actions unmistakable. RPG imagery supplies atmosphere and memory, never replacement terminology or game mechanics.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ruled-paper canvas with midnight text and copper structure.
One dominant cobalt action per view.
Editorial display hierarchy, plain system body copy, and compact mono labels.
One-pixel borders, square corners, and crisp print-register depth.
Pixel art is route identity; academic language remains literal.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only generic primary action color.

rules.name: The State Independence Rule
rules.body: Route accents cannot redefine semantic states or trust.

rules.name: The Literal Language Rule
rules.body: Visual fantasy never replaces academic terminology.

rules.name: The Context Before Decoration Rule
rules.body: Artwork cannot outrank materia, purpose, or action.

rules.name: The Printed Depth Rule
rules.body: Crisp offset depth is structural and deliberately scarce.

dos: Do preserve the search-first path and one obvious primary action.
Do show unknown academic metadata honestly as No informado.
Do record provenance before shipping visual assets.
donts: Don't use source PNGs as default production candidates.
Don't let decoration displace academic terminology.
Don't migrate untouched CSS Modules merely for uniformity.
